hints.title: Concentrate Bit Shifts
hints.text: Multiplying an element by two shifts its binary representation left by one. All k shifts should be applied to the same element to reach the highest bit.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Bitwise Disjunctions
hints.text: Precompute prefix OR and suffix OR arrays to determine the bitwise OR of all other elements in O(1).

hints.title: Evaluate Each Candidate
hints.text: For each index i, evaluate prefix_or[i] | (nums[i] << k) | suffix_or[i + 1] and track the maximum result.

hints.title: Prefix-Suffix OR Sweep Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pass prefix and suffix disjunction precomputation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Splitting k operations among multiple numbers wastes higher-order bit reach.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary prefix and suffix OR tables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that concentrating all k operations on a single element yields the optimal bit position.
